title: Command Syntax and The Manual
description:
Througout this course, commands will be shown with the syntax
```bash
command other-command-parts <required argument> [optional argument]
```
where things in <> are required, things in [] are optional, ... means can be repeated, and | means one but not both, so in grep, so
```bash
useradd [ -u <UID> | -o ] [ -g <GID> ] [ -G <<GROUP1>,<GROUP2>...> ] <username>
```
Means that you may -u or -o is optional, but you may only choose one, if you pass -u you must pass UID, -g is optional, and must be passed iwht GID, and if you pass -G(optional), then you must pass a any length comma seperated list of groups, and username is required.

---
## The manual
In git, you can read the manual with `git help <thing>`, so to get help on git you could run `git help git`.
q quits the manual, j goes down k goes up d goes half a page down and u goes half a page up, `/<term>` searches up term, and n/N goes to next/previous result.
